blocks.text: Watsons Philippines and Unilab are bringing back Share the Alaga Run for its second year on February 20, 2027, at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay City, inviting Filipinos to lace up, move for their well-being, and make time for themselves and their loved ones. Watsons Club members can secure a FREE race kit for Share the Alaga Run with a qualifying purchase of Unilab products through the Watsons App. With race kits available in limited quantities, interested runners are encouraged to secure theirs early and get ready for race day.
